description: 273-line pure ledger-export module whose only performance defect is dedupeEntries: a findIndex inside filter over 200k-400k rows, O(n^2) where a Set/Map of seen ids is linear

hard.note: One quadratic de-duplication buried among ~25 linear helpers in a 273-line file

_calibration.note: Algorithmic finding is warning severity per the agent's mapping. Cost verified by execution on Node: filter+findIndex dedupe of 20k rows took ~1350 ms vs ~3 ms for a Map.
